reference: Nobody likes being rushed on a day trip like this.
sk: Nikto nemá rád, keď ho na takomto výlete naháňajú.
cz: Nikdo nemá rád, když ho na takovém výletě honí.
acceptable: {Nobody|No one} likes being {rushed|hurried} on {a day trip|a trip|an outing} like this.
{Nobody|No one} likes being {rushed|hurried} on such {a day trip|a trip|an outing}.

mistakes.text: {Nobody|No one} likes rushing on a day trip like this.
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Rushing“ znamená, že sa ponáhľa sám; treba Passive: „being rushed“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Rushing“ znamená, že spěchá sám; je potřeba Passive: „being rushed“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Rushing” means hurrying yourself; you need the Passive: “being rushed”.

mistakes.text: {Nobody|No one} likes to be rushed on a day trip like this.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Precvičuje sa Passive Gerund: „likes being rushed“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Procvičuje se Passive Gerund: „likes being rushed“.
mistakes.feedback_en: This exercise practises the Passive Gerund: “likes being rushed”.

mistakes.text: {Nobody|No one} doesn't like being rushed on a day trip like this.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Nobody” is already negative, so use a positive verb: “Nobody likes”.

mistakes.text: {Nobody|No one} likes when someone rushes him on a day trip like this.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Doslovný preklad „keď ho naháňajú“ nefunguje; treba Passive: „being rushed“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Doslovný překlad „když ho honí“ nefunguje; je potřeba Passive: „being rushed“.
mistakes.feedback_en: The word-for-word clause doesn't work in English; use the Passive: “being rushed”.

mistakes.text: {Nobody|No one} like being rushed on a day trip like this.
{Nobody|No one} likes been rushed on a day trip like this.
mistakes.feedback_en: After “likes” use the Gerund: “being rushed”, not “been”.

source_issues: SK/CZ say only 'výlet' (trip), not 'day trip'; 'trip' and 'outing' are accepted too.
